name: Larder Indonesia
overview: Larder Indonesia imports and distributes premium food ingredients from global brands, serving foodservice and retail businesses across Indonesia and selling directly to consumers through online marketplaces.
challenges:
- Build brand awareness among foodservice and retail businesses and individual shoppers.

- Earn B2B buyers’ trust by highlighting product quality and reliable supply.

- Make premium ingredients relevant to consumers by showing how they can use them in everyday cooking and baking.
participants: Project Manager, Performance Specialist, Web Developer, Graphic Designer, Social Media Specialist, Copywriter
role:
- Translated the client’s requirements and campaign goals into a clear brief.

- Helped develop the landing page and briefed the UI/UX specialist on the design direction.

- Oversaw campaign execution to keep it running smoothly together with performance specialist.

- Collaborated with the social media team and graphic designer on campaign content and visuals.

name: Hevit-C
overview: Hevit-C is a vitamin C supplement brand from Hexpharm Jaya. Available in 500 mg and 1,000 mg tablets, it helps consumers meet their daily vitamin C needs.
challenges:
- Stand out against established brands like Redoxon, Holisticare, and Enervon.

- Make vitamin C content relatable to Gen Z, millennials, and young parents.

- Build a consistent TikTok presence and turn interest from CPAS ads into marketplace purchases.

name: Paylabs Indonesia
overview: Paylabs is an Indonesian payment gateway that helps merchants and enterprises accept digital payments. Its platform supports multiple payment methods, including QRIS and bank virtual accounts, so businesses can offer customers more ways to pay.
challenges:
- Modernize the bilingual website while keeping essential merchant information accessible.

- Make payment methods and integration options easier for prospective merchants to find and compare.

- Improve organic visibility for payment gateway searches while prioritizing site speed and security.

name: Helene Omotesando
overview: Helene Stem Cell is a Tokyo-based clinic specializing in regenerative medicine and stem cell therapy. The clinic welcomes international patients and provides Indonesian-language support for those seeking care in Japan.
challenges:
- Build trust with Indonesian audiences considering treatment in Japan.

- Explain the treatment journey clearly, from the first consultation to the clinic visit.

- Turn ad clicks into relevant WhatsApp inquiries and assess lead quality beyond conversion counts

name: Ranaya
overview: Ranaya Training provides practical emergency response and safety training for professionals working in high-risk environments. Its programs help journalists, humanitarian workers, and field teams assess risks, make decisions under pressure, and respond to emergencies
challenges:
- Build awareness among B2B decision-makers in high-risk sectors.

- Show why field teams need hands-on emergency response training.

- Build trust by showcasing trainer credentials and course content.

- Communicate the value of practical training with limited visuals at launch.

name: MSA Safety
overview: MSA Safety develops equipment that helps protect workers in hazardous environments. Its portfolio includes gas and flame detection systems, fall protection equipment, and respiratory protection for industries such as oil and gas, construction, and utilities
challenges:
- Reach specialist B2B audiences, including safety managers and engineers, across APAC.

- Explain technical products through use cases relevant to each industry.

- Adapt messaging by market and allocate budget based on country-level performance.
